title: One lane, one topic: a coordinator starts a new lane for a new topic, and finished lanes get archived
why: Owner ask ask-mw19oqeg4w, Nov 3 16:36 CST: 'repo coordinators assigning totally different work to lane sessions that were on a different topic and then currently have nothing going on, rather than spawning a new lane. Coordinators are also weak on archiving their kids.' Owner correction, 16:40 CST (via coordinator): the unit is a topic, not a step: 'if a lane session was doing some icon work then it was not being talked to for a few hours a coordinator would then give that lane random work like say some bugfixes.'
note: Read on main da8d8073: decision session-tiers:61 gives the batch runner 'archiving finished lanes'; no rule says a lane session keeps to one topic, and no check finds an idle lane left unarchived. Change: session-tiers says a lane session holds one topic; follow-up steps on that topic may go to it, work on another topic starts a new lane. The coordinator's wake report lists idle lanes whose PR merged, and the batch runner archives them. Find first: how a guard on send_message could tell a topic (cs-step tag alone names a step), and whether any archive guard (lane-closes-after-records) blocks archives today. Port: yes, every repo. Ready.
